lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso with roughly equidistant spacing, though density increases slightly in the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the fourth vertical line from the anterior, splitting in the lower-mid region of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 7, 8, and 10 from the anterior exhibit visible discontinuities, appearing as dashed segments rather than continuous vertical lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 4 distinct white spots located on the lower haunch above the stifle joint with a central-focused density.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch show a horizontal geometric alignment parallel to the ventral line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron patch between the orbital regions, two white spots on the lower cheek/mandible area, and a large white transverse patch on the lower neck/throat.
